label: Formal or eminent containment in the Second Replies
term: formal or eminent containment in the Second Replies
definition: In Definition IV, a perfection is contained formally where it is present in the way in which it is perceived. A perfection is contained eminently when what is present differs in quality but suffices to take its place. Axiom V invokes these ways of containing the reality presented by an idea when it characterizes the required cause.
